title: Atlante Yachts Unveils Classic 36 Explorer Yacht with Innovative Aft Deck Lounge and Customizable Interiors
description: Explore the sea in style with Atlante Yachts' Classic 36, featuring an aft deck lounge with an infinity pool and customizable luxury interiors.
html:
Atlante Yachts Introduces Classic 36 with Aft Deck Lounge

Atlante Yachts has announced the addition of the Classic 36 to its explorer yacht lineup. This 36.2-meter model builds on the success of its predecessor, the Classic 35, offering enhanced features and design elements. The Classic 36, designed by VYD Studio, maintains the high-volume hull platform developed by Arrabito Naval Architects, ensuring robust performance and stability. This new model follows the successful launch of the Classic 35 series, which debuted with the yacht Cabana, crafted by the Turkish shipyard Mengi Yay.

The Classic 36 distinguishes itself with an innovative aft deck lounge, featuring an infinity pool and a Jacuzzi on the sundeck. The aft deck is designed for versatility, with folding bulwarks that expand the space and a descending ladder for convenient water access. These enhancements reflect Atlante Yachts’ commitment to combining functionality with aesthetic appeal, providing an inviting environment for relaxation and entertainment.

Enhanced Design: Classic 36 Adds Two Extra Metres

The Classic 36 extends the design of the Classic 35 by two meters, allowing for additional amenities and improved spatial distribution. This increase in length accommodates a spacious aft deck lounge, enhancing the onboard experience with features like an infinity pool. The yacht retains its steel and aluminum construction, ensuring durability and performance on long voyages. The Classic 36 is engineered to offer an “ocean crossing” range exceeding 4,000 nautical miles, supported by twin 850hp IMO Tier III certified Volvo Penta engines.

With a cruising speed of 11 knots and a maximum speed of 14 knots, the Classic 36 is designed for efficient and comfortable travel. The yacht’s beam measures 8.3 meters, and it has a draft of 2.4 meters, optimizing stability and maneuverability. A fuel capacity of 40,000 liters supports extended journeys, making the Classic 36 a suitable choice for those seeking adventure on the open sea.

Customizable Interiors and Impressive Ocean Range

The Classic 36 offers a semi-custom platform, allowing clients to tailor the yacht’s layout, performance, and equipment to their specific preferences. Interior design can be personalized, incorporating contemporary tones and premium Italian materials. Accommodation is configured for 10 guests across five cabins, including a full-beam master suite on the main deck and four guest cabins on the lower deck. The yacht also provides quarters for a crew of seven, ensuring efficient operation and service.

The yacht boasts an interior volume of 338GT, a feature typically found in larger vessels. This generous space allows for an open-plan main saloon, a large skylounge, and ample deck areas, including a sundeck and an upper deck al fresco lounge. The Classic 36 is available for delivery in 2027, and Atlante Yachts continues to expand its portfolio with the recent introduction of the Classic 42, further solidifying its presence in the explorer yacht market.

The Atlante Classic 36 represents a significant advancement in the brand’s explorer yacht offerings. With its enhanced design, customizable features, and impressive range, it is poised to meet the diverse needs of discerning yacht enthusiasts.
